shri lakshmi mata ki divy aarti sangrah ka aanand len | Shree Lakshmi Aarti Collection
Man lakshmi ki aaradhna aur unki kripa prapt karne ke lie sunie Om jay lakshmi mata ki madhur aartiyon ka vishesh sangraha. is bhakti sangrah men alag-alag gaykon ki surili aavaz aur anuthe sangit sanyojan men prastut shri lakshmi mata ki aartiyan shamil hain.
is lakshmi aarti sangrah ki visheshtaen:
Om jay lakshmi mata aarti 7 bar
alag-alag gaykon ki madhur prastutiyan
man lakshmi ki puja aur aaradhna ke lie bhaktimay sangit
dipavli aur lakshmi puja ke lie vishesh aarti sangrah
